Line its axle up with the front chassis mount.
Push it straight in until it stops.
Check both wheels sit level and spin.
detail.parts_line: You'll need: front wheel assembly, front chassis.

text: Lay the base frame flat on the table with its front end facing away from you.

substeps: Lay the base frame flat on the table with its front end facing away from you.
Pick up the front chassis (the shorter chassis block with bracket mounting holes).
Lower it onto the front end of the base frame so the pin holes line up.
Press down until it sits flat with no gap.
detail.parts_line: You'll need: base frame, front chassis.
detail.where: top-down over the front end of the base frame, slightly angled to see the side gap

text: Put the screw through the bracket hole into the front chassis and turn it clockwise until it is snug and the bracket cannot move.
